profile.headline: Strategist | Builder | Teacher | Learner | Software Engineer | AI Developer
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer. Passionate advocate for solid design principles, extensible, maintainable code, and intentional, adaptable architecture. Strategist at heart who starts every plan with a focus on delivering incremental value. Driven by challenge. Motivated to innovate, and improve. An experienced technical leader, dedicated to inspire and empower his team to improve their craft.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: gRPC · Software Systems · Microservices · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Full-Stack Development · Code Review · Back-End Web Development · Unit Testing · Git · Application Architecture · React.js · Databases · Go (Programming Language) · SQL · Software Design · Amazon Dynamodb · Ruby on Rails · Problem Solving · Helm (Software) · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · CircleCI · Agile Methodologies · REST APIs · Parallel Computing · Troubleshooting · Scrum · REST API · Technical Project Leadership · Technical Documentation · PostgreSQL · Docker · Software Development · Software Architectural Design · Cloud Computing · Version Control · RESTful architecture · Apache Kafka

positions.title: Solutions Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and supported the the VMware virtual hosting infrastructure bringing the company from no virtualized production environment to over 85% virtualized with 20+ hosts and 1000+ VMs.

Engineered and documented holistic solutions involving virtualization/cloud hosting, SAN storage, system backup/recovery.

Collaborated on projects with engineers from development and infrastructure teams.

Trained peers in the administration of virtual infrastructure hosting technologies.

positions.title: Infrastructure Engineer II
positions.description:
Lead team which designed and tested business resiliency processes annually, reducing the full time to recovery each year.

Maintained custom PowerShell scripts for automating disaster recovery processes.

Worked with application developers to perform root cause analysis and provide resolution for technical incidents.

positions.title: Systems Support Specialist
positions.description:
Supervised help desk operations requiring, assignment of work orders, training technicians, planning and overseeing projects.

Responded to incidents involving technical issues, and performed root cause analysis.

Designed and supported a virtualized lab environment for the product QA department.

Wrote training documentation for end users and provided instruction in a class setting.
positions.insights: Skills: Problem Solving · Troubleshooting · Technical Project Leadership

positions.title: Tech Support Rep
positions.description:
Provided phone support for external customers.

Provided internal support for desktop computers.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Full Stack Web Development, Ruby on Rails and JavaScript immersive program.

volunteerExperiences.description: For the past few years around the holidays when I have had vacation time to use up, I would use it to volunteer at the shelter.
